items.title: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak
items.summary: "We must get to truth of what happened before, during and after that awful night," the home secretary says while announcing the review.

items.title: Anthropic reveals plans for blockbuster IPO
items.summary: Artificial intelligence giant Anthropic, the company behind the popular Claude chatbot, has filed papers to sell shares to the public for the first time.

items.title: Storm Boelo leaves 90,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning
items.summary: Around 90,000 properties are without power after Scotland and north England is battered by strong winds.

items.title: Trump launches foul-mouthed tirade at Norway - as 'number one fan' Nicki Minaj attends rally
items.summary: Nicki Minaj said Donald Trump "has given us a future to look forward to" as she joined the US president on stage at a rally in Michigan.

items.title: Chris Brown given suspended eight-month prison sentence over nightclub attack
items.summary: The R&B star previously pleaded guilty to affray, after attacking a music producer with a glass bottle.

items.title: Drivers who killed mother and young daughter as they raced are jailed
items.summary: Two strangers who killed a mother and her four-year-old daughter as they raced their high-performance cars along a city centre road have been jailed for 16 and 12 years.
